newText: **Limits (owner decision).** Each student gets **15 questions per day**, changeable at any time in Admin > Settings. Below that limit a student is never shown an error or a queue position; on a busy moment their question simply takes a few seconds longer. Two physical limits sit behind this: HostGator allows 25 simultaneous processes per account, and the AI provider has its own plan limits and cost. Worst case at 15/day is 2,500 students x 15 = 37,500 questions/day.
oldText: **Honest limits.** "Unlimited" here means no daily or per-student cap and no error screens. Two physical limits remain: HostGator allows 25 simultaneous processes per account, and the AI provider has its own plan limits and cost. A student may occasionally wait a few seconds; they are never refused.
